text:
emma: Kicking off a short thread: I drafted a compact troubleshooting reference for 429s, timeouts, and context-limit behavior. Goal: one-page playbook + small SDK snippets and a migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499

nina: I can review the JS and Python snippets. Suggest we show a 'fast-fail for UI' pattern and a 'background retry' pattern.

owen: I'll add an infra blurb: proxies often strip Retry-After. nginx snippet to preserve header: `proxy_pass_header Retry-After; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host $host;`

emma: Good call, Owen. Also flagging model behavior differences: some models truncate and return 200 with a truncation hint header; others return 413. Need a short table.

marta: I'll own the model table. Quick row idea: `model-family: observed -> action` (e.g., mistral-lite: truncates -> prefer prompt trimming + KV reuse).

nina: For SDKs, propose three patterns: naive single retry, robust exp-backoff(+jitter)+idempotency, and circuit-breaker for sustained storms. Small JS example for exp backoff: `delay = Math.min(8000, 250 * 2**attempt) + rand(0,200)`

owen: Ops note: when Retry-After absent, pick adaptive base (250ms) and cap at 8s; emit trace tag `retry.missing_retry_after=true` so SRE can filter problematic clients.

ci-bot: Running checks: docs-lint, link-check.

emma: Migration checklist (short): remove hardcoded 3x sleeps, prefer Retry-After when present, add idempotency keys, enable fallback routing for non-critical paths.

marta: Added model-table draft in PR comments and called out deployments that trim vs reject.

nina: Pushed snippets to sdk-examples branch and added a small unit test that mocks 429+Retry-After. Test command: `npm run test:examples`

ci-bot: link-check failed: broken link to /playbooks/old-rate-limits.

emma: I'll update that to /errors/rate-limits.

ci-bot: All checks passed after fix. ✅

emma: Assigning reviewers: nina (snippets), marta (model table), owen (infra). Please approve if no blockers; I'll merge this afternoon.

marta: LGTM.

own: LGTM, added nginx note.

nina: Approved, tests pass locally.

ci-bot: PR merged by emma  commit a1b2c3d. Release note queued: "docs: consolidated rate-limit & context-limit troubleshooting; added SDK retries and migration checklist."
